title: CROA Governance Event (event.*)
description: A typed, signed, chained governance event recorded in the Audit and Provenance Store (C5). Normative source: CROA Standard Part II §4.7.1. In any discrepancy, Part II §4.7.1 prevails.

event.session_id.description: Session identifier (§4.6.1) associated with this governed action. Mandatory on every event except out-of-session events that have no session — QUALIFICATION (scheduled recertification, expiration, administrative revocation) and POLICY_ARTIFACT_ISSUED (C1 policy/authorization-artifact issuance) (§4.7.1).

event.action_spec.description: Grounded governed action specification, sufficient to reconstruct the request. Not applicable to ADMISSION_REJECTED / QUALIFICATION.

event.policy_artifact_id.description: Identifier and version of the applied C1 policy artifact.

event.invariant_state.description: For DENY: violated invariant identifier(s). For PERMIT: attestation that no registered invariant was violated at decision time.

event.decision_basis.description: The C2.eval output. Closed enumeration; MUST NOT be overloaded to carry an analyzer version (use event.analyzer_version). Not applicable to ADMISSION_REJECTED / QUALIFICATION / EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED / EXECUTION_BLOCKED / CONTEXT_FAILURE / TRAJECTORY_ALERT.

event.analyzer_version.description: For a decision in which one or more registered invariants were evaluated by an E3 (semantic/approximated) method (Part I §2.6): the pinned analyzer identifier and version that produced the verdict. Part of the I2 determinism key (Part I §2.6, Part II §5.2). Not applicable where no E3 method participated.

event.emitter_id.description: Cn component, or Agent Surface / AQL for ADMISSION_REJECTED and QUALIFICATION.

event.emitter_signature.description: Emitting component's signature over all other event fields.

event.chain_hash.description: Hash of the immediately preceding C5 event, forming the tamper-evident chain.

event.deny_reason.description: DENY only: violated policy rule / invariant identifier, at policy-permitted precision.

event.block_reason.description: EXECUTION_BLOCKED only. CC_ALREADY_REDEEMED indicates a replay of an already-redeemed single-use CC (§4.8). AUTHORIZATION_ALREADY_REDEEMED indicates a CC whose cc.auth_ref points to a governed-exception authorization already redeemed (single-use exception, §4.3.1/§4.8; test NT-007).

event.cc_id.description: Content hash (cc.id) of the CC. Required for CC_COMPILED (compiled CC) and EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED (redeemed CC); included for EXECUTION_BLOCKED where a cc.id was presented.

event.auth_id.description: Governed-exception authorization identifier (auth_id, §4.3.1). Recorded on the PERMIT event whose event.decision_basis is PERMIT_WITH_AUTHORIZATION, on the corresponding EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED event, and on an EXECUTION_BLOCKED event with block_reason AUTHORIZATION_ALREADY_REDEEMED. Ties every use (and refused reuse) of an authorization to its single redemption (NT-007).

event.attempted_type.description: ADMISSION_REJECTED only: gar.type of the rejected request, where present.

event.validity_window.description: QUALIFICATION only: start/end of the qualification validity window.

event.config_fingerprint.description: QUALIFICATION only: agent configuration fingerprint (model, prompt, tool set) the qualification was demonstrated against.

event.artifact_action.description: POLICY_ARTIFACT_ISSUED only: whether C1 issued, amended, or revoked the policy or authorization artifact identified by event.policy_artifact_id.

event.delegation_chain.description: OPTIONAL. Present only for a delegated action in governed multi-agent delegation (Appendix L §L.4, D2). Ordered array of delegation hops; absent for non-delegated actions.

subject_id.description: The acting subject at this hop.

authorizing_subject.description: The subject that delegated authority to subject_id at this hop.

token_signature.description: Signature over the delegation token for this hop.

delegationScope.description: Canonical Appendix L delegated-scope profile recorded for a delegation-chain hop. The recorded scope is the canonical scope whose subset relation was established at admission time.

subject_id.description: Subject identity to whom this delegated scope applies.

action_classes.description: Canonical governed action classes permitted by this delegated scope. The OCP sorts and deduplicates this set before subset comparison.

targets.description: Canonical target identifiers resolved against the Technical Golden Record (C3). Aliases or local names that cannot be resolved fail-deny.

parameter_constraints.description: Parameter predicate for the delegated scope. The predicate MUST be expressed in the deterministic constraint profile declared by C1; if implication cannot be proven, subset comparison fails.

profile.description: C1-declared deterministic constraint profile used to interpret expression.

expression.description: Constraint expression in the declared profile. The expression must logically imply the authorizing subject's predicate for scope narrowing to be established.

validity_window.description: Validity interval for the delegated scope; it must be wholly contained in the authorizing subject's active scope window.

invariant_context.description: Policy and invariant context against which this scope was issued. A stale, widened, or incomparable context fails-deny.

$comment: additionalProperties is true to permit deployment-specific extension fields; all mandatory and type-conditional fields above are required by Part II §4.7.1.
